failing_checks.title: Outbound requests and file paths
failing_checks.reason: The bounded adapter fetches whatever URL the caller gives (line 413/421) and follows Location redirects with no host or IP restriction. Enforced controls are limited to scheme checks (line 450: "if (target.protocol !== \"http:\" && target.protocol !== \"https:\") {") and the https-to-http downgrade

failing_checks.title: Stated purpose versus behaviour
failing_checks.reason: The stated purpose is a bounded HTTP wrapper that enforces maxRedirects and maxContentLength. maxContentLength is enforced on both the Node and browser paths (readBodyBounded, line 183). maxRedirects is only enforced in Node (line 389-390). In browser builds with maxRedirects N>0 the code sets redir

failing_checks.title: Core function works
failing_checks.reason: The default feaxios path works. The bounded adapter (used whenever maxRedirects or maxContentLength is set) has defects that break its core behaviour. postForm sends a JSON body under a form-urlencoded header (line 157, already recorded).
